notes.title: TIME TO SAY GOODBYE
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone,
After many months, I come back to you to give you two messages: good and bad. Let's start with the bad one.[/h1]

For technical reasons related to the loss of all [i]"Flame of Memory"[/i] project files, the game can no longer be developed. It is likely that the sale will be completed shortly and[b] it will no longer be possible to buy it[/b]. I'm glad that some of you like this game. The people who bought it will still be able to play it from what I know. However, this is the end of bad news.

As a game developer, I want to grow all the time. Some time ago, together with my friend, we started the production of our common computer game called [i]"Beekeeper"[/i]. It is an economic strategy based on running your own apiary. If you are interested in this project, you can go to its [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1074510/Beekeeper/]website[/url] in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1074510/Beekeeper/]Steam Store[/url].

[b]The premiere of the game in the Early Access version should take place soon.[/b]

I hope you will understand this situation. You are the best!

notes.title: FLAME OF MEMORY IS LEAVING EARLY ACCESS!
notes.content:
The production of Flame of Memory has been successfully completed. However, this does not mean that game updates are interrupted. :)

What's new:

+ NEW CHALLENGE: TRY TO PASS TROUGHT THE FOREST UNNOTICET BY THE ENEMY (during each expedition)

+ AT THE END OF EACH NIGHT, A CARD FROM THE DIARY APPEAR. YOU CAN READ A FEW WORDS ABOUT THE WELL-BEING OF SOLDIERS.

+ SELECTING THE GAME MODE (GAME WITH FINISH / GAME WITHOUT FINISH)

+ the experience system is working normally for now 

+ the skill system is working normally for now 

+ button animations in the menu and skills tab have been improved

+ other bug fixes

notes.title: FLAME OF MEMORY NOW ON LINUX OS!
notes.content: Flame of Memory is available for Linux operating systems!

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - FLAME OF MEMORY
notes.content:
New features:
- new GUI style
- clear system  of hints, just one click when you do not know what you should do now
- experience system
- skills tree
- bug fixes
- new soundtrack and sounds
- and more!

notes.title: TRADING CARDS
notes.content: Now you can get trading cards, badges, emoticons and profile backgrounds in Flame of Memory!

notes.title: DIFFICULTY LEVELS
notes.content: I just added difficulty levels to the game. You can check it in in-game options and play Flame of Memory on easy, medium or hard difficulty. :)

notes.title: RELEASE!
notes.content:
Flame of Memory has been released! You can buy it now on Steam Store page. 

Remember that, this is Early Access version and you can leave suggestions about it in comments below. :) The more content will be in the future.
